tab1.role_description: A typical week for a junior Software Engineer at an Indian company involves fixing bugs tracked in Jira, writing unit tests, reviewing pull requests on GitHub or GitLab, and attending daily standups. They contribute to backend APIs or frontend components under senior guidance, update Confluence documentation, and use tools like IntelliJ IDEA or VS Code. In IT services companies, they may rotate across client projects involving Java or Python stacks. Expect to read tickets, write code, test locally, and raise PRs every day.

In IT services companies, they may rotate across client projects involving Java or Python stacks. Expect to read tickets, write code, test locally, and raise PRs every day.
tab1.narrative_para2: GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, and Claude are actively reshaping this role by generating boilerplate code, writing first-draft unit tests, and suggesting fixes during debugging. AI handles repetitive scaffolding and documentation drafting, freeing engineers for logic-heavy work. What remains firmly human: understanding business requirements, making architectural trade-offs, debugging context-specific production issues, and communicating clearly with cross-functional teams. AI accelerates output but cannot replace engineering judgment.
tab1.narrative_para3: This role suits people who enjoy solving logic puzzles, can tolerate ambiguous requirements, and are comfortable asking questions when stuck rather than guessing. Patience for debugging and a habit of reading documentation carefully are genuine assets. Those who thrive tend to be methodical, curious about how systems work under the hood, and not easily frustrated when code breaks in unexpected ways. A willingness to learn continuously as a daily habit matters more than any single skill.
tab1.typical_employers_india: MNCs, IT Product Companies, Startups, IT Services

ai_exposure.tasks_assisted: AI tools like GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, and Claude assist software engineers with code generation, debugging, boilerplate writing, and documentation drafting, covering a significant portion of routine coding tasks. Automated testing frameworks augmented with AI can generate test cases, reducing manual effort. Code review tools with AI capabilities can flag issues and suggest improvements in real time.
ai_exposure.human_value: Software engineers bring architectural judgment, understanding of business context, and stakeholder communication that AI cannot replicate. Creative problem-solving for novel, domain-specific challenges, ethical decision-making in design trade-offs, and mentoring junior developers remain distinctly human responsibilities.

tab1.role_description: A Data Analyst in India extracts, analyses, and visualises data to help organisations understand trends, measure performance, and make better decisions. Day-to-day work involves writing SQL queries, building dashboards in Power BI or Tableau, cleaning and transforming datasets in Python or Excel, and presenting insights to business stakeholders. Data Analysts are in very high demand across India — in IT services, banking, e-commerce, healthcare, and product companies — making this one of the most accessible well-paying entry points in the technology sector for graduates from engineering, maths, statistics, and even commerce backgrounds.
tab1.narrative_para1: A Data Analyst in India extracts, analyses, and visualises data to help organisations understand trends, measure performance, and make better decisions. Day-to-day work involves writing SQL queries, building dashboards in Power BI or Tableau, cleaning and transforming datasets in Python or Excel, and presenting insights to business stakeholders. Data Analysts are in very high demand across India — in IT services, banking, e-commerce, healthcare, and product companies — making this one of the most accessible well-paying entry points in the technology sector for graduates from engineering, maths, statistics, and even commerce backgrounds.
tab1.narrative_para2: AI is heavily reshaping data analysis. Power BI Copilot generates dashboards from natural language prompts and surfaces anomalies automatically. Tableau AI creates narrative summaries of chart trends. ChatGPT and Claude generate and debug SQL queries, Python wrangling scripts, and chart interpretation text. This is an AI-Evolving role with high AI exposure — routine query writing and chart creation are increasingly AI-assisted. The human advantage — asking the right business question, interpreting ambiguous data in context, and communicating insights persuasively — becomes more central and more valuable.
tab1.narrative_para3: Data Analysis suits people who are curious about what numbers are really saying and enjoy finding stories in datasets. If you like combining logical thinking with communication — turning a complex analysis into a clear recommendation for a non-technical manager — this is a very strong career path. Comfort with SQL is the core entry skill; Python is increasingly expected. You don't need to be a mathematician, but an instinct for questioning data quality and an eye for patterns help enormously. This is one of the best-value roles in Indian tech: high demand, accessible entry requirements, and clear upward paths.
tab1.typical_employers_india: Manufacturing Plants, PSUs, EPC Companies, Auto OEMs
tab1.ai_impact: AI is heavily reshaping data analysis. Power BI Copilot generates dashboards from natural language prompts and surfaces anomalies automatically. The human advantage — asking the right business question, interpreting ambiguous data in context, and communicating insights persuasively — becomes more central and more valuable.

ai_exposure.tasks_assisted: Data Analysts benefit heavily from AI with ChatGPT/Claude generating and debugging SQL queries, Python data wrangling scripts, and chart descriptions. Power BI Copilot and Tableau AI (Pulse/Einstein) automate insight generation, natural language querying, and anomaly detection within dashboards. Alteryx accelerates self-service data preparation workflows, significantly reducing manual transformation effort.
ai_exposure.human_value: Data Analysts interpret ambiguous business questions, understand organisational context behind metrics, and communicate findings to non-technical stakeholders in a way that drives decisions — skills AI lacks. Designing the right question to ask of data, and understanding when numbers tell an incomplete story, require domain knowledge and human judgment.

tab1.role_description: An AI Product Analyst in India works at the intersection of AI capability and product strategy — evaluating AI system quality, writing AI product requirement documents, conducting competitive analysis of AI features, performing user research on AI experience, and helping product teams make informed decisions about AI feature development. This role has emerged as product companies and GCCs increasingly need people who understand both AI capabilities and product development — bridging data science, product management, and AI evaluation disciplines.
tab1.narrative_para1: An AI Product Analyst in India works at the intersection of AI capability and product strategy — evaluating AI system quality, writing AI product requirement documents, conducting competitive analysis of AI features, performing user research on AI experience, and helping product teams make informed decisions about AI feature development. This role has emerged as product companies and GCCs increasingly need people who understand both AI capabilities and product development — bridging data science, product management, and AI evaluation disciplines.
tab1.narrative_para2: AI Product Analysts use ChatGPT and Claude extensively for drafting AI product requirement documents, competitor analysis synthesis, and user research summaries. OpenAI API and Anthropic Claude API usage is central to their AI evaluation workflows. GitHub Copilot assists with SQL and Python analysis scripts. Perplexity AI accelerates AI market research. This is an AI-Evolving role with high AI exposure in research and documentation, while the human core — translating business goals into AI product specifications, evaluating AI user experience, and advocating for responsible AI design — requires judgment that only deep product and AI domain knowledge provides.
tab1.narrative_para3: AI Product Analysis suits people who are deeply curious about both AI capabilities and user experience — those who can evaluate whether an AI feature actually serves users well, not just whether it technically works. If you enjoy synthesising technical AI knowledge with product strategy thinking, can communicate AI system limitations honestly to non-technical product teams, and care about responsible AI product development — this is a compelling emerging role. Strong analytical skills, professional English, and genuine interest in AI product development are the core requirements. MBA or engineering backgrounds both provide relevant foundations.
